title: Centralized Recovery for Distributed Enterprise Workloads
business: Large enterprises managing heterogeneous workloads across multiple Google Cloud environments that require unified data protection.
problem: Fragmented backup strategies lead to inconsistent recovery points, increased management overhead, and potential data loss during regional outages.
solution: Google Cloud Backup and DR provides a centralized, policy-driven service to manage backups and disaster recovery for supported Google Cloud workloads, ensuring consistent recovery objectives.
steps: Provision the Backup and DR management console within the primary Google Cloud project.
Define backup and disaster recovery policies specifying retention periods and recovery point objectives.
Assign resources such as Compute Engine instances or databases to the configured management policies.
Monitor backup status and verify recovery readiness through the centralized dashboard.
outcome: Improved operational efficiency and reduced recovery time objectives through a single pane of glass for all enterprise data protection.
limitation: The service is limited to supported Google Cloud workloads; users must verify compatibility via the service console to ensure specific resource types can be managed.
